argv: n=0; total=0; for f in $(find "Build/DerivedData/InteractiveDemo/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/InteractiveDemo.app" -type f); do file "$f" | grep -q Mach-O || continue; c=$(nm -a "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -i -c -E 'projectm|milkdrop'); s=$(nm -a "$f" 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "$c projectm/milkdrop of $s symbols: $f"; n=$((n+c)); total=$((total+1)); done; echo "Mach-O files scanned: $total; matches: $n"; [ $total -ge 4 ] && [ $n -eq 0 ]
